mission: The African Free Fire Community (AFC) is dedicated to fostering a competitive and supportive environment for Freefire players across Africa. Our mission is to promote esports, develop talent, and create opportunities for players to showcase their skills on a global stage.
vision: We envision a thriving African Free Fire esports scene that is recognized worldwide for its talent, passion, and professionalism. Through our efforts, we aim to elevate African players and teams to compete at the highest levels of international tournaments.
hub: The AFC Hub is a competitive Free Fire esports platform. Players create a profile, build and manage teams, register for tournaments and scrims, climb the monthly rankings, and track their match stats and achievements, all in one place.
googleSignin: Signing in with Google is optional. If you choose it, AFC only uses your name and email address to create and sign you into your AFC account. We never post to your Google account or access any other Google data. See our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> for how your data is handled.
valueIntegrity: Integrity: We uphold the highest standards of fair play and sportsmanship.
valueCommunity: Community: We foster a supportive and inclusive environment for all players.
valueExcellence: Excellence: We strive for continuous improvement and excellence in all our endeavors.
valueInnovation: Innovation: We embrace new technologies and strategies to advance the Freefire esports scene.
valueEmpowerment: Empowerment: We provide resources and opportunities for players to develop their skills and achieve their goals.
